name: Deseos de Verano
source:
When leaving your home, you found out the joy of life in the village far away from where you grew up with the boys there.

Look into your new friends' lives and form bonds that help you overcome your past trauma.

[Translated from [url=https://srapolo.itch.io/deseos-de-verano]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你离开家时，你发现了远离你和孩子们一起长大的村庄的生活乐趣。

了解新朋友的生活并建立联系，帮助你克服过去的创伤。

[译自[url=https://srapolo.itch.io/deseos-de-verano]Itch.io[/url]]
